# Governance Is Embedded in Delivery

## Statement

Governance controls shall be built into the delivery workflow as automated checks and review steps, rather than applied as a separate documentation phase at the end.

## Rationale

End-of-process governance finds problems when they are most expensive to fix and turns governance into paperwork.

## Implications

- Controls have triggers inside the workflow (pull request, model check-in, deployment).
- Automated validation produces VALID / WARNING / BLOCKING ERROR, as this repository does with `00-system/validation/dakb.py`.

## Consequences

- Positive: earlier feedback, less bureaucracy, evidence generated automatically.
- Negative: requires tooling and explicit, machine-checkable rules.

## Applicability

Architecture and data delivery; this knowledge base itself.

## Exceptions

Governance decisions requiring human judgement remain human ([[Knowledge Repository Governance]]); automation provides evidence, not approval.
